narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The triangles go one, three, nine, so the holes go the same as the triangles.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Old holes never fill in, and new holes are added to them each step.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows holes 1, 3, 9; the old big hole flashes; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, draw Step three and count twenty seven shaded triangles.
<bookmark mark='holes'/>Then count its holes, and you should find thirteen in all.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Twenty seven minus one is twenty six, and half of that is thirteen.
removed_beats.on_screen: the Step 3 frame glows with 27 shaded triangles and 13 holes; the rule is checked beside it

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the holes go one, three, nine, the same as the triangles. Old holes stay, so the holes are one, four, thirteen.
